concerns.text: T060, T061, T062, T063, T064, T065, T066 implement mechanisms (Formal Language of Admissible Questions, Knowledge Gap Verification against truth set, Attention Analysis, Productive Ignorance Metric, System 2 Checkpoint) that have no corresponding FR/SC in spec.md or plan element in plan.md. These tasks introduce a 'teacher/verification' architecture contradicting the spec's 'negative selection' core, leaving the spec's FR-001 to FR-008 without coverage for these new, unapproved features.

T060 (Formal Language of Admissible Questions) and T062 (Knowledge Gap Verification Gate) are listed in Phase 2/Phase N+1 but have no matching requirement in spec.md (FR-001 to FR-008) or plan.md. The plan.md defines data generation via a 'frozen Critic Model' and 'templates' (Phase 1), not a formal language or truth-set verification. These tasks are orphaned from the spec's defined scope.

T015b (Ablation data generator) lacks explicit coverage for the 'syntactic complexity matching' requirement defined in plan.md's 'Complexity Tracking' table. While T015b mentions 'neutral placeholder text' and T015a calculates token length, neither task explicitly mandates generating a distractor that matches the *syntactic structure* of the critique, which is a critical plan element to isolate the 'content' effect per FR-007.

T034 and T043 are duplicate tasks both requiring documentation of the 'operational distinction' in `docs/philosophy.md`. T034 is in 'Phase N' and T043 is in 'Phase N+1' (marked [Review]). This duplication suggests a stale tag or copy-paste error, creating redundant work for the same requirement.

T063 (Attention Analyzer) and T065 (Productive Ignorance Metric) are tagged as 'Review: Turing' and 'Review: Rockmore' but have no corresponding FR/SC in spec.md or plan element in plan.md. These tasks address reviewer comments that were not incorporated into the final spec/plan, making them orphaned tasks with no defined requirement to satisfy.
